format: WSDC Registry Events, score reports and judge anonymity

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Results include contest rounds, placements and score reports; judges may be listed anonymously (Judge 1, Judge 2, etc.) on the score report at the Event Director / Owner / Chief Judge's discretion.

requirement: A WSDC profile must treat judge anonymity on the score report as an authorized EVENT-LEVEL choice by the Event Director, Owner or Chief Judge, recorded with who chose and when; it is not a DanceFlow global setting.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: Which of the three roles decides when they disagree is not stated; the event-level role designations come from OD-06 (PR 834). The 30-day access and correction duties are in OD22-WSDC-0001.
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
decision_refs: OD-23 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A required for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
